title: Design System: IM 即时通讯

title.purpose: Chat headers, panel titles. Used sparingly for hierarchy establishment.

body.purpose: Message content, list items. Primary reading text. Max line length 65ch.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus, dialogs, tooltips. Only shadow in the system — used when an element lifts from the surface.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover transitions, background shifts, and state changes. Ease-out-quint character.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover state transitions, focus ring appearances.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action: send message, confirm dialog, submit form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(52% 0.12 265); color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.1, 0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(44% 0.12 265); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(52% 0.12 265); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: oklch(88% 0.005 265); color: oklch(65% 0.008 265); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background: #fff; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.005 265); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.1, 0.99); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: oklch(97% 0.002 265); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(52% 0.12 265); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Self Message Bubble
components.description: Message bubble for the current user. Right-aligned, neutral light background.
components.html:
你好，今天见面吗？
已读
components.css: .ds-msg-row { display: flex; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-bubble-self { max-width: 70%; padding: 10px 14px; background: oklch(92% 0.005 265); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); word-break: break-word; } .ds-msg-status { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-msg-status.read { color: oklch(52% 0.12 265); } .ds-msg-status.sent { color: oklch(48% 0.01 265); }

components.name: Other Message Bubble
components.description: Message bubble from other users. Left-aligned, white background.
components.css: .ds-msg-row { display: flex; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-bubble-other { max-width: 70%; padding: 10px 14px; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); word-break: break-word; }

components.name: Conversation Item
components.description: A single conversation row in the sidebar list. Shows avatar, name, last message, time, and unread badge.
components.html:
张
张三14:30
好的，下午见2
components.css: .ds-conv-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.1, 0.99); border-left: 3px solid transparent; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-conv-item:hover { background: oklch(97% 0.002 265); } .ds-conv-item.active { background: oklch(52% 0.12 265 / 0.1); border-left: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.12 265); border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; } .ds-conv-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-conv-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-conv-name { font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); } .ds-conv-time { font-size: 12px; color: oklch(48% 0.01 265); } .ds-conv-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-conv-last { font-size: 13px; color: oklch(48% 0.01 265); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 180px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input field for forms and search.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="搜索用户名或昵称" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.005 265); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.1, 0.99); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(65% 0.008 265); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(52% 0.12 265); }

components.name: Chat Input Area
components.description: The message composition area at the bottom of the chat window. Textarea with send button.
components.html: Enter 发送
components.css: .ds-chat-input { background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.005 265); padding: 8px 16px 12px; } .ds-textarea { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: oklch(18% 0.01 265); background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.005 265); border-radius: 6px; outline: none; resize: none; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.1, 0.99); } .ds-textarea:focus { border-color: oklch(52% 0.12 265); } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: oklch(65% 0.008 265); } .ds-send-row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-tip { font-size: 12px; color: oklch(48% 0.01 265); }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: Online/offline status dot with text label. Always paired — color alone is insufficient.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-dot.online { background: oklch(62% 0.16 145); } .ds-dot.offline { background: oklch(90% 0.005 265); }

narrative.overview: 这个设计系统追求通透与呼吸感。像推开一扇窗——界面元素退到背景中，让消息内容自然流动。没有厚重的容器，没有喧宾夺主的装饰，每一像素都为信息的清晰传递服务。它服务于 PRODUCT.md 定义的
人格。克制但不冰冷：中性的底色上有一抹克制的 accent，微妙的灰度层次传递温度。色彩策略为 Restrained——主色调覆盖面积不超过任何屏幕的 10%，它的稀缺性即是它的力量。这个系统明确拒绝：渐变色大背景、微信绿气泡、玻璃态模糊效果、侧边条纹边框、以及任何
的装饰性设计。静态区域保持平面，仅悬浮元素使用极轻阴影。
keyCharacteristics: 通透的层级：通过底色微差区分功能区，不依赖边框和阴影
信息即主角：消息气泡用中性色，仅靠位置（左/右）区分己/彼
克制的 accent：单一冷调蓝靛，只出现在链接、选中态、已读确认
微妙不等于无趣：浅蓝底调的中性色让

rules.name: The 10% Rule
rules.body: Sky Ink 在任何屏幕上的覆盖面积不超过 10%。它出现在链接、选中态、焦点环、已读标记——永远作为点缀，不作为底色。

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: 禁止使用 CSS 渐变作为背景。登录页的紫色渐变替换为纯 Page 底色。色彩由 accent 的点状出现提供，不由大面积渐变提供。

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: 不引入 Web Font。PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei 已是各自平台最优中文阅读字体。零额外加载保持界面轻快。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 静态元素不使用阴影。仅当元素需要浮起时才引入 Panel Float 阴影。

dos: 使用底色微差（Surface / Page / Chat Area）区分功能区域，不依赖边框

自己和他人的消息气泡使用中性色，仅靠左右位置区分

保持消息气泡圆角为 10px，正文 14px/1.6 行高
donts: 使用 CSS 渐变作为背景。登录页的紫色渐变必须移除
使用微信绿 (#95ec69) 或任何高饱和色作为气泡背景
对静态表面使用阴影。面板和卡片 resting 状态保持平面
使用 border-left > 1px 作为彩色装饰条
引入第二个 accent 色。Sky Ink 是唯一的品牌色
使用 emoji 作为界面装饰，不使用渐变文字
